summary: When an unprotected hero tries to apply a saddle to an adjacent cockatrice, steed.c:use_saddle calls trap.c:instapetrify before continuing its saddle checks. js/steed.js records note_unported at that call and continues, so the death message and stoning stop path are skipped. The admitted replay first differs at step 103 on the attempted saddle; the diagnostic records trap.c instapetrify as unported.

source.branch: In use_saddle, the target is visible and not already saddled; it has touch_petrifies, the hero has no gloves or Stone_resistance, and the hero neither changes into a stone golem nor resists stoning. C formats the killer text and calls instapetrify before the remaining saddle validation.

evidence: The saved accepted v52 evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-4cd4881552c06e139c24162766546ede1f17aeea-v52.json measures the assigned case at 110/114 screens, 3151/3151 RNG calls, and 111/114 cursors, with no runner error.
The case recipe challenges steed.c:use_saddle with a visible hostile cockatrice, a barehanded human wizard, and an applied saddle; its comment states the independently chosen seed and setup.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/steed.c:36-80 calls instapetrify(kbuf) after the touch message when touch_petrifies(ptr), !uarmg and !Stone_resistance hold and the hero does not successfully turn into a stone golem.
Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:3844-3855 checks Stone_resistance and polymon before printing the stoning message, setting svk.killer, and calling done(STONING).

JS js/steed.js:375-385 has the same branch and preconditions but calls note_unported("trap.c instapetrify") instead of the existing js/trap.js:374-392 helper. The focused replay at .cache/C-v52-saddle-cockatrice-scan.json first differs at step 103 and lists trap.c instapetrify as unported.

The change needed is limited to wiring this use_saddle call to the existing helper with its state and environment; it does not claim whole steed.c:use_saddle or trap.c:instapetrify completion. The separate can_ride caller remains outside this target.
